finding: We tested whether declining uncertain local-goal reports reduces errors at useful coverage. At 2,048 labels and an abstention cost of 0.1, separate-step reporting retains 76.43% coverage and lowers the predictive bank's error among reported steps from 13.45% to 0.12%. Independent reconstruction, all 1,920 paired estimates and both complete replays verify this constructed-method tradeoff. The forecast is unchanged; historical goal correspondence and human intent remain unestablished.
